study type: Observational study with gene expression profiling
cohort: The study included placentas from 11 women with obesity and obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) and 9 women with obesity and no OSA.
finding: Although there were no statistically significant overall differences in placental gene expression after correction for multiple testing, unadjusted analyses and gene set enrichment analysis revealed alterations in genes related to O-linked glycosylation, Wnt signalling, and the reversible hydration of carbon dioxide in placentae from women with obesity and OSA compared to those without OSA.
cross-section timing: At the time of placental collection (post-delivery)
